name: Salons & Barbershops
title: Referral Partners for Salons and Barbershops | Local Impressions
description: We visit the bridal shops, boutiques and studios near your salon or barbershop in Oak Brook, Lombard and Hinsdale. You see every sign-up in your portal.
cardBlurb: Your stands go to the gyms, yoga studios and juice bars near you.
intro: We find businesses near you where people get ready for a big day. Every month we visit them and introduce your salon or barbershop by name.
partnersIntro: People getting ready for a wedding, an interview or a night out stop here too.

partners.name: Bridal shops
partners.why: Once the dress is chosen, brides and their wedding parties think about hair.

partners.name: Clothing and menswear stores
partners.why: Shoppers buying an outfit for an event often want a fresh cut to match.

partners.name: Photography studios
partners.why: People booking headshots and portraits want to look their best on camera.

partners.name: Gyms and fitness studios
partners.why: Members with a routine for how they look often keep a standing haircut too.

partners.name: Tailors and dry cleaners
partners.why: Regulars are getting suits and dresses ready for weddings and interviews.

partners.name: Event venues and planners
partners.why: Every wedding, gala and party they host has guests who want their hair done.

treatsIntro: We bring coffee and treats for the whole staff at every stop.
treatExamples: Coffee and scones for a bridal shop's Saturday team
Muffins and coffee for a gym's early front desk crew
Cookies and coffee for a dry cleaner's afternoon counter staff
portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal. You or your front desk call and book them like any other client.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: When our team visits, you and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No competing chairs
notes.text: We never visit other salons or barbershops for you.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We introduce your salon or barbershop only in words you approve.

exclusivity: When our team visits, partners agree to promote one salon or barbershop like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Can we keep the relationships we already have?
faq.a: Yes. We skip businesses you already work with unless you ask, and those relationships stay yours.

faq.q: Do I need to come along on the visits?
faq.a: No. Our field team makes every visit, and you see each stop in your portal.

faq.q: What do you leave at each business?
faq.a: We leave your approved displays, with permission, and a card for each staff member. We restock every month.
